fact: The ministry's page states that the national strategy for the development of the digital economy (Vision Congo Digital 2025) was presented in Brazzaville on 9 August 2019, had been approved by the Council of Ministers on 2 May 2019 and was published by decree n° 2019-150 of 17 June 2019.
title: La vision Congo digital 2025 pose ses jalons
publisher: Ministère des Postes, des Télécommunications et de l'Économie numérique
